title: Understanding Spectral Clustering
text: Spectral clustering involves using a specific type of matrix to find clusters in data. This matrix is derived from the graph representation of the data.

title: Types of Matrices in Graphs
text: In graph theory, there are several matrices associated with a graph, such as the adjacency matrix, the distance matrix, and the Laplacian matrix. Each serves a different purpose.

title: Role of the Laplacian Matrix
text: The Laplacian matrix is crucial in spectral clustering because it helps in finding the eigenvalues and eigenvectors that are used to partition the graph into clusters.
